source: clementina-mia src/mia/hardware/gpio_mapping.h (6502 bus, reset, IRQ, audio) and src/mia/sd/sd.c (microSD)
notes: The GPIO pins of the Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W that runs MIA, as wired on the rev 1 board. Every GPIO on the Pico header is listed; GPIO 23-25 and 29 belong to the Pico's Wi-Fi chip.
define names the firmware macro; offset is the pin's position after a base macro. The SD and audio pins are build-time defaults that the board is wired to.
function is the RP2350 peripheral that drives the pin: PIO for the 6502 bus, SPI0, PWM, or SIO for plain software control.
Connector pinouts, power and parts are in the clementina-hardware README; the address decode is in cpu-memory-map.json.
